summary: Iter 215ak — Mobile Phase 2 Operator Surfaces testing complete. Verified mobile responsive layouts for /memberships (Members, Invoicing, Check-in tabs) and CRM Loop. All key mobile features implemented correctly: card list on Members tab, single-column grids, overflow-x-auto tables, bottom-sheet dialogs, full-width drawers. Minor issue: body has horizontal scroll on mobile (cosmetic, doesn't affect functionality).

ui_bugs.issue: Body has horizontal scroll on mobile viewport (390x844). Content is contained but body.scrollWidth > body.clientWidth

action_items: Consider adding overflow-x: hidden to body or html element to prevent horizontal scroll on mobile

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all mobile features working, minor horizontal scroll issue)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile Phase 2 operator surfaces tested. Rate limiting (429) encountered during desktop regression tests - may need to wait between login attempts. All mobile responsive CSS classes verified in code review.

desktop_regression.notes: Rate limiting (429) prevented full desktop regression testing. Code review confirms desktop table (hidden md:block) and mobile list (md:hidden) classes are correctly implemented.

horizontal_scroll_issue.description: Body has horizontal scroll on mobile. This is a cosmetic issue - content is properly contained within overflow-x-auto wrappers, but the body element itself allows horizontal scrolling.
horizontal_scroll_issue.suggested_fix: Add overflow-x: hidden to body or html element in index.css
